name: LHI
recent: Leong Hup 的董事及大股东在 2026 年 11 月 10 日至 12 日期间通过 Emerging Glory Sdn Bhd 在公开市场连续增持公司股份。公司此前公布 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度净利为 1.017 亿令吉，按年增长 12.6%，但按季下滑 11.6%。此外，公司子公司已获准暂缓执行 MyCC 及仲裁庭的相关决定，以进行司法复核。
notable: 董事及大股东通过 Emerging Glory Sdn Bhd 在公开市场连续三日增持公司股份。
公司子公司获得暂缓执行 MyCC 及仲裁庭决定，以进行司法复核。
公司公布 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度净利 1.017 亿令吉，按年增长 12.6%。
risks: 公司子公司涉及 MyCC 及仲裁庭案件，目前处于司法复核阶段。
季度净利按季下滑 11.6%，净利率由 5.1% 降至 4.6%。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 22.08 亿令吉，按年增长 3.5%，按季下滑 2.5%；净利为 1.017 亿令吉，按年增长 12.6%，按季下滑 11.6%；净利率为 4.6%，低于上一季度的 5.1%。

recent_en: Leong Hup's directors and substantial shareholders, through Emerging Glory Sdn Bhd, have been acquiring shares in the open market from 10 to 12 November 2026. The company earlier reported a net profit of RM101.7 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, up 12.6% year-on-year but down 11.6% quarter-on-quarter. Separately, a subsidiary has been granted a stay of the MyCC and Tribunal decisions pending a judicial review.
notable_en: Directors and substantial shareholders acquired shares in the open market for three consecutive days through Emerging Glory Sdn Bhd.
A subsidiary obtained a stay of the MyCC and Tribunal decisions pending a judicial review.
The company reported a net profit of RM101.7 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, up 12.6% year-on-year.
risks_en: A subsidiary is involved in MyCC and Tribunal proceedings, currently under judicial review.
Quarterly net profit fell 11.6% quarter-on-quarter, with net margin declining from 5.1% to 4.6%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM2.208 billion, up 3.5% year-on-year and down 2.5% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM101.7 million, up 12.6% year-on-year and down 11.6% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 4.6%, lower than 5.1% in the previous quarter.
